events.what: Guth and Maynard prove N(σ,T) ≤ T^(30(1-σ)/13+o(1)), lowering the supremum zero-density exponent from 12/5 to 30/13
Tao, Trudgian and Yang obtain further zero-density exponent improvements by systematic (non-AI) optimisation over the ANTEDB

judgement.doubts: Agree with the record. The density hypothesis asks A(σ) ≤ 2 on the whole range; both events lower exponents that stay above 2 where they apply, so they are bounds, not cases. Tao's Copilot use was for expository graphs in a blog post and the ANTEDB optimisation is computer-assisted, not AI (F9). The 'first improvement over Ingham' phrasing is the record's; not re-checked.
